Alibaba Group (BABA) Shares Rose While Hartwell J M Limited Partnership Has Boosted Its Holding; Chevy Chase Trust Holdings Continues to Hold Position in Cognex (CGNX)
May 21, 2018 - By Migdalia James
Hartwell J M Limited Partnership increased its stake in Alibaba Group (BABA) by 26.55% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Hartwell J M Limited Partnership bought 27,680 shares as the company’s stock rose 3.18% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund held 131,925 shares of the business services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $22.75 million, up from 104,245 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Hartwell J M Limited Partnership who had been investing in Alibaba Group for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $507.68 billion market cap company. The stock increased 1.32% or $2.58 during the last trading session, reaching $197.58. About 9.03M shares traded. Alibaba Group Holding Limited (NYSE:BABA) has risen 68.29% since May 21, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 56.74% the S&P500.
Chevy Chase Trust Holdings Inc increased its stake in Cognex Corp (CGNX) by 101.74% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Chevy Chase Trust Holdings Inc bought 565,975 shares as the company’s stock declined 13.83% with the market. The institutional investor held 1.12M shares of the industrial machinery and components company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $68.64M, up from 556,272 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Chevy Chase Trust Holdings Inc who had been investing in Cognex Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $7.95B market cap company. The stock increased 1.19% or $0.54 during the last trading session, reaching $45.99. About 614,927 shares traded. Cognex Corporation (NASDAQ:CGNX) has risen 31.99% since May 21, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 20.44% the S&P500.
